themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that perform research tasks autonomously, including data analysis, information gathering, and generating insights.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and refactoring code, as well as automating code-related tasks.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and applications designed to facilitate and accelerate research processes across various domains.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Includes articles discussing AI's ability to condense large volumes of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries for easier understanding.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles detailing the use of AI to analyze and interpret user sentiment from reviews, social media, and other feedback channels.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research and development of AI chatbots, including their capabilities, limitations, and impact on user interaction and mental well-being.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers AI applications in automating software testing processes, including test generation, execution, and analysis for improved quality assurance.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is used to understand market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes for product development and strategy.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial users or personas for testing, simulation, and research purposes, often involving deepfakes or AI-generated content.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is influencing job markets, including job displacement, creation, and the reskilling of the workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
